asset.name: LogViewer
asset.description: The virtualized streaming log surface with pause and follow, search, severity filters, timestamps, wrapping, selection, and export.

requires.reason: Windowing and focus preservation are shared.
Certainty and urgency treatment is shared rather than reinvented per surface.

signatureMoment.description: Scrolling up pauses the follow automatically and a single clear control resumes it, so a streaming log can be read without fighting the stream.

rationale: The most demanding performance case in the catalog: unbounded append at high frequency, where a naive implementation re-renders the window on every line and becomes unusable within a minute.
